name: stata-research-guard
description: Provides Stata main rules, a closed command dictionary, complete selected-command guides, and selected raw paper context.

interface.shortDescription: Main rules, closed dictionary, full guides, and raw paper context.
interface.longDescription: Lets the model inspect a closed 109-command Stata dictionary, choose exact canonical commands, and retrieve only those commands' complete StataCorp or maintainer guides and compact paper profiles. Exact selected paper blocks can then return their original occurrences and optional directly linked raw log or artifact context. Commands outside the dictionary and commands without a full guide abort. The plugin does not scan projects, score or rank candidates, promote templates, productize paper audits, grade generated code, or certify a research design.
defaultPrompt: Use the skill and get_stata_command_evidence to read the main rules and command dictionary, choose exact commands, then read their complete guides and selected paper context.
Treat paper examples and optional raw logs as nonbinding source context; preserve the current project and selected research specification.
Abort if a required command is outside the dictionary or its complete guide is unavailable; do not substitute or hand-implement it.
